basic_info.description: Stately, extensively remodeled Marina-style home built in 1925 enjoys sweeping views of the Marina Green and the San Francisco Bay. Spanning an impressive 2,665 square feet across two levels, this grand residence features 3 beds, 3 baths. From the entry foyer enter the full width living room with views directly out to the Marina Green and beyond. Gorgeous inlaid hardwood floors, fireplace, recessed lighting. Double doors lead to the formal dining room and remodeled chef's kitchen with Viking gas range, microwave and refrigerator. Quartz counters, marble tile backsplash. The main level enjoys a large primary suite with luxury marble bath plus two additional bedrooms and a second full remodeled bath.The garden level features a large family room suite, home office and spa-like full bathroom with large soaking tub, custom tile shower and dual vanity. The suite opens to an exclusive use rear landscaped garden and patio. Laundry room with full size washer/dryer, one car parking and storage complete this exceptional home. Ideal Marina location across the street from the Marina Green and close to Crissy Field, East Beach, the Presidio, Fort Mason, Chestnut and Union Streets. Updated systems. 2-unit building offers potential fast-track condominium conversion. Some photos have been edited.
